e: Iranian forces attack ship navigation systems on Didamar Island, causing an unknown amount of damage.

The Royal Navy of Oman rescues 25 crew members from the RITI, a tanker flying the Panamanian flag that was transporting two million barrels of crude oil when it was attacked and caught fire 1.6 nautical miles (3.0 km) off the coast of the Musandam Governorate.
The United States imposes a 12.5% tariff on Oman, citing the presence of alleged forced labour in the supply chain.
Two people are killed in a drone strike on the al-Awahi Industrial Area in Sohar.
The government orders the evacuation of vessels from the Mina Al Fahal oil port.
Deputy prime minister Fahd bin Mahmoud Al Said dies at the age of 85.
Indirect negotiations between Iran and the United States regarding the nuclear program of Iran are held in Muscat.
A tourist boat capsizes in the Gulf of Oman off Muscat, killing three French nationals.
